# FSM_REST UML Index

**Workshop moniker:** @TrentBest  
**Purpose:** Navigate source-grounded structural diagrams and use cases. Diagrams are manually authored unless a page explicitly says otherwise; no page is claimed to be generated by AST/reflection or GUI.SVG.

## Architecture views

- [FSM_REST Core UML](FSM_REST.Core.UML.md) — descriptor, binding, request construction, transport, response.
- [REST request execution](RestRequestExecution.UML.md) — execution boundary and transport substitution.
- [RestApiDescriptor](RestApiDescriptorUML.md) — API description record and expected consumers.
- [RestOperationDescriptor](RestOperationDescriptor.UML.md) — reusable operation metadata.
- [RestGuiMapping](RestGuiMapping.UML.md) — presentation and host-state mapping metadata.
- [RestGuiInputMapping](RestGuiInputMapping.UML.md) — one parameter's input/state binding.
- [RestGuiOperationExecutor](RestGuiOperationExecutor.UML.md) — input resolution, execution, result publication.
- [RestGuiNodeFactory](RestGuiNodeFactory.UML.md) — optional Workshop GUI tree adapter.

## Coverage policy

Each production source file must have a neighboring companion. Each public class, record, or interface must have a focused UML page or be explicitly represented as a target in a cohesive diagram with a use-case section. Pages identify their target, source, purpose, relationships, scope, provenance, and verification path.

## Known gap

The inventory is substantially expanded, but this index does not yet prove that every declared public type has an individually complete UML page or that every relative link resolves. Follow [FSM_REST Documentation Readiness](../FSM_REST.DOCUMENTATION_READINESS.md) for remaining audit and CI work. Do not interpret documentation coverage as runtime proof.
